skills.name: Dynamic equilibrium
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: At equilibrium, forward and reverse reaction rates are equal. Reactions continue and concentrations stay constant.

skills.name: Law of mass action
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: In the equilibrium expression, each concentration is raised to its stoichiometric coefficient. Pure solids and liquids have unit activity.

skills.name: Equilibrium constant Kc
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Kc is the ratio of product to reactant concentration terms at equilibrium. Its value depends on temperature.

skills.name: Kp and gaseous moles
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn, where Δn is gaseous product coefficients minus gaseous reactant coefficients.

skills.name: Le Chatelier’s principle
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: A system shifts to oppose a concentration, pressure or temperature change. A catalyst changes the rate of reaching equilibrium, not its position.

skills.name: Standard quadratic form
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: A quadratic has the form ax² + bx + c = 0, with a ≠ 0. Move every term to one side before identifying coefficients.

skills.name: Factorisation
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: Write the quadratic as a product equal to zero. At least one factor must be zero; solve both factors.

skills.name: Discriminant
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: D = b² − 4ac. D > 0 means two distinct real roots; D = 0 means equal real roots; D < 0 means no real roots.

skills.name: Quadratic formula
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: For ax² + bx + c = 0, x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac))/(2a). Keep the entire numerator over 2a.

skills.name: Word problems
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: Define the variable, form a quadratic and check roots against the context. Lengths and counts must be valid.

skills.name: Pure substances and mixtures
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: A mixture contains substances in variable proportions; physical separation can often recover components.

skills.name: Colloids and suspensions
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Colloidal particles scatter light, making the beam path visible under suitable conditions.

skills.name: Atomic number and mass number
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Mass number is the number of protons plus neutrons: 11 + 12 = 23.

skills.name: Valency and formulae
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Electrical neutrality requires two Al3+ ions and three O2- ions, giving Al2O3.

skills.name: Distance and displacement
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Displacement depends on final and initial position. They are the same after a complete lap.

skills.name: Acceleration
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Acceleration is change in velocity divided by time: (10 - 2)/4 = 2 m/s2.

skills.name: Newton's laws
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Newton's second law gives net force F = ma = 3 x 2 = 6 N.

skills.name: Mechanical advantage
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Mechanical advantage is load divided by effort: 120/30 = 4.

skills.name: Diffusion and osmosis
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Osmosis involves water moving through a selectively permeable membrane down its water-potential gradient.

skills.name: Epithelial and connective tissues
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Tendons connect muscles to bones. Ligaments connect bones to other bones.

skills.name: Flowers and pollination
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Pollination transfers pollen. Fertilisation is fusion of gametes, which occurs later.

skills.name: Binomial nomenclature
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: A binomial consists of a genus name followed by a specific epithet.

skills.name: Rational and irrational numbers
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The square root of 2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers; the other listed numbers are rational.

skills.name: Arithmetic progressions
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: This arithmetic progression has common difference 3. The next term is 13 + 3 = 16.

skills.name: Degree and coefficients
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The degree is the greatest exponent of x with a nonzero coefficient, here 3.

skills.name: Linear pairs
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: A linear pair sums to 180 degrees, so the second angle is 180 - 65 = 115 degrees.

skills.name: Plate tectonics
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Plate tectonics describes movement and interaction of lithospheric plates over geological time.

skills.name: Neolithic settlements
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Neolithic changes included cultivation and domestication, encouraging more settled communities in many regions.

skills.name: Features and types
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Democracy requires meaningful participation and institutions through which rulers can be held accountable.

skills.name: Opportunity cost
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Choosing one option sacrifices the next-best feasible alternative; its value is the opportunity cost.

skills.name: Balancing equations
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Balancing conserves the number of atoms of each element and reflects conservation of mass.

skills.name: Neutralisation
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Neutralisation is an acid-base reaction producing salt and, in common school examples, water.

skills.name: Reactivity series
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Zinc is more reactive than copper and can displace it from copper sulfate solution.

skills.name: Homologous series
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: A homologous series shares a functional group and general formula; successive members typically differ by CH2.

skills.name: Lens power
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Power is 1/f with f in metres: 1/0.5 = +2 dioptres.

skills.name: Vision defects
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: A concave lens diverges incoming rays so a myopic eye can focus distant objects on the retina.

skills.name: Resistance and Ohm's law
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Ohm's law gives R = V/I = 6/2 = 3 ohms, at constant physical conditions.

skills.name: Safety
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: A series fuse in the live wire breaks the circuit when excessive current melts its element.

skills.name: Transport
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Xylem carries water and mineral ions; phloem transports organic food between sources and sinks.

skills.name: Neurons and reflexes
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Reflex pathways allow rapid involuntary responses to stimuli through neural circuits.

skills.name: Mendelian patterns
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: The genotypes are AA, Aa, Aa and aa. Under complete dominance, three show the dominant phenotype.

skills.name: Trophic levels
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: The ten-percent model approximates energy transfer between trophic levels; most energy is not transferred onward as biomass.

skills.name: nth term
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The nth term is a + (n - 1)d. Here it is 3 + 9 x 2 = 21.

skills.name: Distance formula
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The distance formula gives sqrt(3 squared + 4 squared) = sqrt(25) = 5.

skills.name: Standard angles
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: Sine is the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse for an acute angle in a right triangle.

skills.name: Simple probability
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: There are three even outcomes among six equally likely outcomes, so the probability is 3/6 = 1/2.

skills.name: Civil disobedience
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Gandhi's Salt March challenged the salt law and became a major event in the Civil Disobedience Movement.

skills.name: Division of powers
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Federal arrangements divide powers between levels of government under constitutional rules.

skills.name: Primary secondary and tertiary
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Manufacturing transforms raw materials into other goods, a defining activity of the secondary sector.

skills.name: Formal and informal credit
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Formal banking operates under legal and regulatory frameworks; terms still need to be examined by borrowers.

skills.name: Mole concept
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Number of moles is mass divided by molar mass: 18/18 = 1 mol.

skills.name: Ionisation enthalpy
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Effective nuclear attraction generally increases across a period, though subshell and pairing effects create exceptions.

skills.name: First law
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: With w defined as work done on the system, internal-energy change equals heat supplied plus work done on it.

skills.name: Oxidation numbers
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Four oxygens contribute -8. The ion totals -2, so sulfur must contribute +6.

skills.name: Dimensions
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: From F = ma, force has dimensions mass times length divided by time squared.

skills.name: Projectile motion
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: With gravity as the only force, acceleration acts vertically; horizontal acceleration is zero.

skills.name: Escape speed
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Neglecting atmosphere and rotation, escape speed is sqrt(2GM/R), independent of the escaping object's mass.

skills.name: Thermal equilibrium
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: The zeroth law expresses the transitive nature of thermal equilibrium and underlies temperature measurement.

skills.name: Cell organelles
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Mitochondria contain the machinery for key stages of aerobic respiration and oxidative phosphorylation.

skills.name: Calvin cycle
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: RuBisCO catalyses carboxylation of RuBP in the Calvin cycle, initiating carbon assimilation.

skills.name: Double circulation
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Pulmonary and systemic circuits bring blood through the heart twice in one complete circulation.

skills.name: Meiosis
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: Meiosis reduces chromosome number, supporting sexual reproduction and restoration of the diploid number at fertilisation.

skills.name: Cartesian products
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The Cartesian product contains one ordered pair for each choice from A and B: 3 x 2 = 6.

skills.name: Combinations
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: Order does not matter, so use combinations: 5C2 = 5 x 4 / 2 = 10.

skills.name: Derivative as rate
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: The power rule gives d(x to the n)/dx = n x to the n - 1, so d(x squared)/dx = 2x.

skills.name: Standard deviation
skills.subject: Mathematics
skills.description: Variance measures mean squared deviation. Standard deviation is its nonnegative square root and has the data's units.

skills.name: Writing
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Written records supported accounting, administration and communication in complex urban societies.

skills.name: Fundamental rights
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Constitutional recognition and judicial remedies provide mechanisms for protecting Fundamental Rights.

skills.name: Production possibility frontier
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: A PPF represents feasible production trade-offs under specified resource and technology assumptions.

skills.name: Seismic waves
skills.subject: Social Science
skills.description: Seismic S-waves require shear rigidity and do not propagate through liquids; this helps infer Earth's internal structure.

skills.name: Van't Hoff factor
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Dissociation increases the effective number of solute particles, giving i greater than one in the idealised treatment.

skills.name: Nernst equation
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: The relation Delta G = -nFEcell means positive cell potential corresponds to negative Gibbs-energy change.

skills.name: Half-life
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: For a first-order process, t1/2 = ln(2)/k, so it does not depend on initial concentration.

skills.name: Ligands and coordination number
skills.subject: Chemistry
skills.description: Denticity counts donor atoms from one ligand attached to a metal centre. Two donor atoms make it bidentate.

skills.name: Gauss's law
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: Total electric flux through a closed surface equals enclosed net charge divided by vacuum permittivity.

skills.name: Kirchhoff's rules
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: At a junction without charge accumulation, total current entering equals total current leaving.

skills.name: Lenz's law
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: The induced response opposes the flux change, consistent with energy conservation; it does not always oppose the existing field.

skills.name: de Broglie waves
skills.subject: Physics
skills.description: The de Broglie relation is lambda = h/p, linking wavelength with particle momentum.

skills.name: Double fertilisation
skills.subject: Biology
skills.description: One male gamete fuses with the egg; the other fuses with the central-cell nuclei in the usual angiosperm description.

skills.name: Transcription

skills.description: Transcription synthesises RNA using a DNA template, with base-pairing and enzyme-controlled polymerisation.
